create_tensorboard_recorder: create a TensorBoardRecorder instance with an output directory and metric descriptor registry
record_metric_values: record metric values to TensorBoard for a given category and step number
add_value_to_writer: add a scalar, text, or sequence value to a TensorBoard SummaryWriter
get_or_create_writer: get or lazily create a cached SummaryWriter for a specific metric category
close_recorder: close all TensorBoard SummaryWriters and clear the cached writers dictionary
